scientific_readiness_exploratory_results.interpretation: The apparent H6 efficiency ordering flips solely with the fan-out charging contract in this toy. Future H6 science must freeze communication accounting and match coordination quality before comparing workspace to direct routing.

hypothesis_or_reduction_question: Can an apparent coordination/efficiency advantage for capacity-limited workspace broadcast be created or removed solely by fan-out charging and direct-router destination knowledge?
synthetic_or_dev_inputs_used: Exact analytic binomial expectations over fixed synthetic consumer fan-out and router-knowledge grids; no formal, sealed, official, or held-out data.
implementation_or_experiment_performed: Implemented an exact analytic direct-router expectation model and two deliberately different workspace communication-accounting contracts, pinned the accounting flip with tests, documented the non-evidentiary boundary, fixed lint mechanically, and obtained green exact-head CI.
observations: Under shared-slot accounting workspace efficiency is strictly higher in 19/20 scenarios and ties in 1/20.
Under recipient-charged accounting direct routing is strictly more efficient in 20/20 scenarios.
Perfect direct-router knowledge saturates the fixed four-recipient budget: recall 1.0 at fan-out 1/2/4, 0.5 at fan-out 8, 0.25 at fan-out 16.
At fan-out 8 and knowledge 0.25, direct expected recall is about 0.303 while workspace recall is 1.0, but the efficiency ordering still flips with accounting alone.
Initial exact-head CI failed only at lint; a formatting-only change produced replacement CI 35229064353 success.
what_would_falsify_or_reduce_it: This diagnostic is reduced if a prospectively fixed communication-cost contract plus matched coordination quality makes workspace and direct-routing conclusions invariant to reasonable fan-out charging, or if strong direct/shared-state/attention comparators erase the workspace advantage.
candidate_formal_question: Under a prospectively fixed communication-cost contract and matched coordination quality, does a capacity-limited workspace retain a coordination/communication advantage over direct routed communication, a shared recurrent-state reduction, and other matched alternatives across a predeclared module/fan-out regime?
